method.renderer: Production write_latex_pdf with extended convergent compilation; instrumentation only adds LuaTeX status log lines every 100 pages and at end of document.
method.timed_scope: Complete write_latex_pdf call including rendering, media copying, and all convergent LuaLaTeX passes; synthetic snapshot/model/media preparation and PDF audit excluded.
method.rss_sampling: One-second ps samples of LuaLaTeX/LuaHBTeX processes during the renderer call; page memory checkpoints are associated with the current compiler pass.
method.comparison: One instrumented production build; not a paired performance comparison.

interpretation: The three-pass instrumented production build completed and its semantic audit exactly matched the prior full-build record.

The tagged second and third passes ended at 391933 KiB and 396922 KiB for Lua collectgarbage count (about 382.75 MiB and 387.6 MiB), while peak process RSS was 1151.89 MiB. These are different measures; their ratio is only indicative.
RSS and Lua heap both grew substantially across the tagged passes. The profile does not isolate media, PDF object, or allocator contributions.
The 351.98-second duration includes page-level instrumentation and is not a paired timing result.
